main.description: A photo in an atview gallery. Stores the image blob alongside accessibility text, an optional caption, and categorization tags.

blob.description: The photo image file. May be up to 2 MB.

alt.description: Alt text describing the photo for accessibility.

description.description: Optional caption or longer description of the photo.

tags.description: Tags used to categorize or filter gallery photos. Avoid prepending tags with hashtags.
